_game: ViZDoom: Health Gathering Supreme (Doom navigation; COOM engine)
_note: pip install vizdoom. The acid-floor maze: health drains every tic, so you have to keep finding medikits to stay alive. 'Supreme' is the hard variant of HealthGathering -- a maze rather than an open room, and poison vials that hurt you mixed in with the medikits. No weapon, no attack button.
_keys_note: Action indices are scenario-specific. For VizdoomHealthGatheringSupreme-v1 the Discrete(4) map is 0=noop, 1=MOVE_FORWARD, 2=TURN_RIGHT, 3=TURN_LEFT (verify with env.unwrapped.button_map). 'keys' are always these Discrete indices; env_kwargs.max_buttons_pressed picks how held keys combine: 0 = MultiBinary (keys OR together, e.g. walk forward while turning), 1 = Discrete (one key wins). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_audio_note: env_kwargs.audio_buffer_enabled turns Doom's sound on: it arrives in obs['audio'], is played through the session's speakers, and is logged per frame. Doom makes 1/35 s of sound per step, so fps * env_kwargs.frame_skip must be 35: the session stops the block otherwise, because sound could not follow the frames.

text: The floor is acid and your health drops all the
time. Explore the maze and walk over medikits to
top up. Avoid the green vials -- they hurt you.
